title: Usage event signing and quota-reconciliation playbook for non-repudiable billing evidence
creator: Sana Iqbal
description: Create an operational playbook and implementation work for cryptographic signing of incoming usage events, deterministic quota counter reconciliation, and packaging of SOC-ready artifacts that prove billing correctness. Deliverables: (1) spec for signing format and KMS integration, (2) reconciliation algorithm and SLA for eventual consistency, (3) detection and alerting for divergence/tamper, (4) automated evidence bundling for SOC/audit requests, (5) migration plan for historical events.
acceptance_criteria: All incoming usage events are signed with AZ KMS-backed keys and signatures are persisted alongside raw events
Reconciliation job runs within 5 minutes of event ingestion 99.9% of the time for hosted customers
Divergence alert triggers when invoiceable token delta exceeds 0.5% or absolute 1000 tokens for a customer
Evidence bundle generator produces: signed raw event batch, reconciliation report with before/after counters, and a signed attestation file for SOC requests
Migration plan covers safe backfill for 180 days of high-volume tenants without violating rate limits or doubling billed tokens
tasks: Spec: signing envelope format (fields, canonicalization, signature metadata) and rotate-key strategy
Integrate signing into ingestion path and KMS: handshake with keys service + client library changes
Persist signatures in event store and expose verification API for auditors
Design reconciliation stream: deterministic partitioning by customer+period and idempotent counter updates
Implement divergence detector with adaptive thresholds and playbook for investigaton
Build evidence-bundler CLI that composes signed events + reconciliation trace + metadata manifest
Add RBAC rules so only 'billing-audit' role can produce signed evidence bundles
Run canary rollout for 10 low-risk customers, validate with synthetic traffic and manual spot-checks
Document SOC artifact format and include verification steps for external auditors

notes: Design choice: symmetric signing using KMS keys so we can rotate without invalidating historical attestations
Trade-off: signing at ingestion adds ~6ms median overhead — compensated by batching signatures in ingestion pipeline
Alternate considered: append-only Merkle tree for global proof; tabled because of complexity and slower verifier UX
Compliance packaging: we'll provide verifier scripts and public key endpoints to auditors for signature checks
